text.en: Believing ordinary double beta decay and neutrinoless double beta decay are simply two names for the same observed process -- ordinary double beta decay, which conserves lepton number and emits two antineutrinos along with two electrons, has been directly observed in several nuclei and is fully consistent with the Standard Model; the neutrinoless variant is a distinct, hypothetical process that has never been observed, would violate lepton number conservation, and would only be possible under a specific, currently unconfirmed assumption about the neutrino's fundamental nature.
text.et: Arvamus, et tavaline topeltbeetalagunemine ja neutriinovaba topeltbeetalagunemine on lihtsalt kaks nime samale vaadeldud protsessile -- tavaline topeltbeetalagunemine, mis säilitab leptoni arvu ja kiirgab kaks antineutriinot koos kahe elektroniga, on otse vaadeldud mitmes tuumas ja on täielikult kooskõlas Standardmudeliga; neutriinovaba variant on erinev, hüpoteetiline protsess, mida ei ole kunagi vaadeldud, mis rikuks leptoni arvu jäävust, ning mis oleks võimalik ainult konkreetse, praegu kinnitamata eelduse all neutriino fundamentaalse loomuse kohta.
